--- Bucket.v1beta1.s3.aws.m.upbound.io/checkout-app-db-logs.apps
+++ Bucket.v1beta1.s3.aws.m.upbound.io/checkout-app-db-logs.apps
@@ -1 +1,18 @@
+apiVersion: s3.aws.m.upbound.io/v1beta1
+kind: Bucket
+metadata:
+  annotations:
+    crossplane.io/composition-resource-name: logs
+  labels:
+    crossplane.io/composite: checkout
+  name: checkout-app-db-logs
+  namespace: apps
+spec:
+  forProvider:
+    region: us-east-1
+    tags:
+      Environment: production
+      Purpose: application-logs
+  providerConfigRef:
+    kind: ProviderConfig
+    name: default

--- HorizontalPodAutoscaler.v2.autoscaling/checkout-app.apps
+++ HorizontalPodAutoscaler.v2.autoscaling/checkout-app.apps
@@ -1 +1,24 @@
+apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
+kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
+metadata:
+  annotations:
+    fmp.tobiash.github.io/producer: HelmRelease apps/checkout-app
+  labels:
+    helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/name: checkout-app
+    helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/namespace: apps
+  name: checkout-app
+  namespace: apps
+spec:
+  maxReplicas: 8
+  metrics:
+  - resource:
+      name: cpu
+      target:
+        averageUtilization: 70
+        type: Utilization
+    type: Resource
+  minReplicas: 4
+  scaleTargetRef:
+    apiVersion: apps/v1
+    kind: Deployment
+    name: checkout-app

+metadata:
+  annotations:
+    fmp.tobiash.github.io/producer: HelmRelease apps/checkout-app
+  labels:
+    helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/name: checkout-app
+    helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/namespace: apps
+  name: checkout-app
+  namespace: apps
+spec:
+  ingressClassName: nginx
+  rules:
+  - host: checkout.example.test
+    http:
+      paths:
+      - backend:
+          service:
+            name: checkout-app
+            port:
+              number: 80
+        path: /
+        pathType: Prefix
